description: This file defines the CustomAuthStateProvider class, a custom implementation extending AuthenticationStateProvider, responsible for managing user authentication state in a Blazor application. It fetches user info from a web API, caches the user data, and manages authorization headers for subsequent requests.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of AuthenticationStateProvider that manages user authentication by fetching user data from a web API and caching it for performance Optimization.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide the current authentication state, utilizing cached user data when applicable.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user information, utilizing cache if valid, otherwise fetching fresh data from the API.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Makes an HTTP request to retrieve user info, constructs a ClaimsPrincipal with claims, and sets authorization headers.
